title: Gateway current_superframe does not compile due to signed epoch arithmetic
description: rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs current_superframe derives unix as u64 but parses the configured epoch as i64, then passes it to u64::saturating_sub. This is a hard compile failure. Parse/validate the epoch into a nonnegative u64 (or explicitly handle pre-epoch values) and cover the boundary semantics.
close_reason: Stale: current_superframe (rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:1443-1456) was rewritten — unix is derived as u64 from SystemTime::now() duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH) with map_or(0), and the superframe id is computed by superframe_id_at(unix, duration) using plain u64 division with an explicit duration==0 -> 0 guard. No i64 epoch parse and no saturating_sub remain; the claimed hard compile failure does not exist. Verified by compilation and green tests: cargo test -p lichen-gateway (all suites pass) and cargo clippy -p lichen-gateway clean earlier this session. No files changed.
